title: The skew Brownian motion should not be used as a risk-neutral returns process: a well-posed skew-normal alternative
abstract: arXiv:2609.15306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Return models for risk-neutral financial valuation based on skew Brownian motions (SBMs) have been introduced about twenty years ago, and have recently enjoying growing popularity. Unfortunately, the story behind their development is one of mistakes and erroneous interpretations, beginning from the foundational misrepresentations that the prevalent financial model is based on the It\^o-McKean SBM -- which, in fact, it is not. Besides, and more seriously, the clarification of \cite{rossello2012arbitrage} that price models with a local time in their returns, such as the SBM, are arbitrageable   has been, by and large, ignored.   In this paper, we try to clear the field from the confusions and misconceptions lurking in the standing option pricing literature on SBM, by exposing all the errors we could trace in the treatment so far. translated_title: 偏布朗运动不应用作风险中性收益过程：一个适定的偏正态替代方案
translated_abstract: 基于偏布朗运动（SBM）的风险中性金融估值收益模型大约在二十年前被提出，近年来日益受到欢迎。遗憾的是，其发展背后的故事充满了错误和误解，首先是那种流行的金融模型是基于Itô-McKean偏布朗运动这一基础性错误表述——事实上并非如此。此外，更严重的是，Rossello（2012）关于收益中包含局部时间的价格模型（如偏布朗运动）是可以被套利的这一澄清，在很大程度上被忽视了。在本文中，我们试图通过揭示迄今为止SBM期权定价文献中能够追溯到的所有错误，来澄清该领域中潜藏的混淆和误解。然而，鉴于SBM偏正态边际分布在风险中性估值中的潜力，作为积极的……
tldr: 本文系统揭示了偏布朗运动期权定价文献中的诸多错误，指出其收益模型可被套利因而不适用于风险中性估值，并提出以偏正态边际为基础的适定替代方案。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes the errors and misconceptions in the skew Brownian motion option pricing literature, argues that SBM return models are arbitrageable and thus unsuitable for risk-neutral valuation, and proposes a well-posed skew-normal alternative.
